description: Reported the scold and the short hem.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Said Kemp will keep what he made, and covered the drum.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Said he stole the shoes in time, and asked to wear them.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Came off wet, claimed the paper and the slippers, and refused Sam the shoes.
name: Will Kemp

description: Named the eleven lines and the two hundred bars, and went home.
name: William Shakespeare
